I had a really frustrating experience at Feather Stone Health Clinic in Southall. I requested a prescription while I was in significant pain, and after being seen, I was told it would be ready the next day. Based on that assurance, I returned expecting to collect my medication.

However, when I went back, they refused to issue the prescription and suddenly said they needed further documentation — something that was never mentioned before. Now I’ve been told I have to wait another four days because the doctors work remotely and none of them are logged in.

It’s unacceptable to leave a patient in pain due to poor communication and lack of organisation. If additional documentation was needed, that should have been clearly explained from the start. The whole process felt disorganised and dismissive. I would not recommend this clinic based on my experience.

I also asked my other prescription to be on repeat and they still haven’t done it I was also discriminated against in the clinic in front of a manager and yet I wasn’t even given an apology.

Waste of time and space they nhs are closing down hospitals and clinics this clinic should be first on the list

To respond to your request - When I came in i explained why I needed the prescription on the NHS as the local pharmacies were not accepting it. As I was in a lot of pain and could not stand the receptionist said she will do the medication for me the next day and I did come in. When I came in the next day the receptionist said it not ready. I asked her if she could email a DR to see if I can get it today and I dont mind waiting .. her response was our DR are all offline so I cannot do nothing. She didnt evem try. Knowing the fact I was in pain she said why are you complaining just wait a few days your not even in pain. This is discrimination and I made it very clear to everyone. Including the manager who was there. The Dr laughed and the receptionist even stood up and Shouted in which I told her to stop shouting as I am not Shouting ... look on your CCTV. and you can confirm this.
